The main takeaway from our work is that
structural information on a biocatalyst is a key factor for its improvement.
structural information on enzymes involved in the degradation of recalcitrant compounds can be exploited to generate improved enzymes that degrade a broader range of compounds.
the structure-guided approach can be used to engineer enzymes with new activities, which is a powerful tool for biotechnology.
